# Butler v0.0.19

## Change Log

- Added Windows x64 desktop distribution through a Squirrel Setup executable,
  including first-run and uninstall lifecycle handling, in-app GitHub Release
  updates, community-signing verification, and a Microsoft Store-ready
  distribution boundary. (#124, #128, #129, #132)
- Added native composer file drag-and-drop, image attachment previews, a
  dismissible Git installation notice, and hardened Windows package/runtime
  behavior. (#132)
- Refreshed the hosted model catalogs and request contracts, separated Z.AI
  Coding Plan from the general Z.AI API, and added ordered backup models that
  continue work on retryable provider, quota, and availability failures. (#133)
- Added OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models while preserving the selected
  install model across runtime and App settings. (#89)
- Promoted the BTCC R3 guided work runtime with durable planning, execution,
  review, recovery, cancellation, exact provider-result continuity, and
  Project Ledger-backed progress.
- Added event-driven SSE activity and context updates for active app turns, and
  bounded memory and artifact snapshots.
- Added responsive desktop/mobile layouts, unified composer presentation,
  improved project creation and session navigation, and kept live work progress
  visible without scroll flicker or orphan activity rows. (#101, #102, #103,
  #109)
- Returned macOS distribution to a signed and notarized DMG containing a single
  Butler app, and unified App-owned Agent lifetime, tray ownership, guarded
  shutdown, and legacy service migration across desktop platforms. (#107)
- Removed Linux App systemd service payloads and separate App-service release
  artifacts; existing App-owned user units migrate on first foreground launch.
- Upgraded Electron to 41.10.4 to clear the Windows packaging audit gate. (#134)
